applicability.full_trigger_absence_proof: No full assessment trigger applies. This is one bounded correction to unshipped builder and gate scripts, introduces no abstraction, module, class, interface, or public API, and changes no public_api trigger. It adds no external or security integration, changes no lifecycle_or_state, concurrency, persistence, or security_sensitive_behavior, and touches no governance_core_path. It only refuses more local output paths before anything is created; the existing tracked-sources paragraph already forbids untracked and non-regular files from reaching a kit, and no canonical capability requirement or requirement text changes.

security_justification.audit_integrity: No audit event, contract, identity calculation, checksum format, or integrity assertion changes; the correction only refuses local output paths before kit construction.
security_justification.authentication_or_authorization: No authentication or authorization mechanism changes; the local builder and clone gate use no principal, permission, or access-control decision.
security_justification.authority_provenance: No authority source, signature, provenance field, owner decision, or release authorization changes; the builder only rejects pre-existing local output.
security_justification.concurrency: No concurrent scheduler, shared state, lock, worker, or asynchronous coordination behavior changes; refusal happens within one builder invocation before creation.
security_justification.confidentiality: No secret, credential, or confidential payload handling changes; diagnostics name only caller-provided local paths and an archive path.
security_justification.cryptography: No cryptographic algorithm, digest computation, key handling, signing, or verification behavior changes; existing kit identity material remains unchanged.
security_justification.error_disclosure: The new diagnostics describe invalid local output ownership without exposing kit contents, credentials, or data beyond the provided destination or archive path.
security_justification.external_security_integration: No external security product, network service, exporter, collector deployment, or third-party security integration is introduced or changed.
security_justification.fail_posture: The builder fails before copying, sealing, archiving, or creating output that already exists, and measured controls prove the gate fails when either refusal is removed.
security_justification.lifecycle: No SDK, sink, operation, package, or release lifecycle transition changes; temporary build cleanup is narrowed to paths the builder created.
security_justification.mutation_ownership: The builder refuses output it does not own before mutation, while clone checks and controls use disposable copies and fresh temporary directories.
security_justification.privacy_transformation: No privacy transformation, data classification, redaction, prohibited-data scan, or personal-data processing behavior changes.
security_justification.resource_retention: No storage or retention policy changes; kit output remains transient local filesystem material and refusal prevents replacing an existing archive.
security_justification.retry_or_redelivery: No retry, delivery, redelivery, queueing, or attempt behavior changes; the correction concerns local kit construction before any evaluation run.
security_justification.trust_boundary: The existing repository and local-output boundaries remain in place; refusing existing output adds no principal, trust crossing, or external trust boundary.
